confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Tallinn price levels, not live listings. Restaurant and coffee anchors are the most reliable. Accommodation is less certain because July is peak season and rates vary widely by location and booking lead time. Cocktail and wine_glass are bounded using the local beer relationship, since direct knowledge is weaker. FX value 0.6955 for 2026-10-15 comes from a search-result summary that cites the RBA exchange rates page; I did not open that page directly, and no 2026-10-16 RBA figure was confirmed.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Baltic capital and mid-sized European tourist-city price levels, using Riga and Vilnius as the closest comparables, with Helsinki as an upper bound. Euro-area pricing with Tallinn's Old Town tourist premium in summer.
